description:
The variable **retry_limit** is defined as an integer that controls the maximum number of retry attempts; its purpose is described as “Maximum number of retries allowed.” Its initial setting is **5**, and the variable is scoped globally, meaning it is available across the entire system. The configuration specifies that, if the variable becomes full, the oldest entries should be discarded using an LRU (least‑recently‑used) strategy; if no value is present, it should be initialized to the defined default, and any attempt to store a value that exceeds the allowed size will be truncated.  

The entry has a reference count of **3**, indicating three components currently depend on it, and it is set to expire at Unix timestamp **1735689600**. All of these settings together ensure that retry limits are enforced consistently while providing clear fallback behavior.
